tools.name: enigma_request
tools.title: Request secrets
tools.description: Asks the user to enter one or more secret values out of band. Uses MCP URL-mode elicitation. Never returns a value (ADR-001).

tools.name: enigma_reveal
tools.title: Reveal a secret to the user
tools.description: Opens a one-time, out-of-band disclosure of a secret value to the human via MCP URL-mode elicitation, or copies it to the clipboard on macOS. Never returns the value (ADR-001).
